comparison.objective: Mount one shaft between fixed and sprung bench centres; candidate separates ceramic media from steel washers in a supported screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a release lever while aligning two shaft centre holes versus symmetric tab grasping, dynamic loose-load control, agitation, and screen replacement.
comparison.success_condition: Both points seated, lever at rest, shaft still and released versus target recovery, washer retention, no spill, dual support, hand clearance, and 3-second dwell.
comparison.reason: The record tests constrained precision seating into opposed centres, not selective many-body passage. Missing rubric details: none material.
